about: Isaiah was a great prophet. He told about God's holiness and the Savior who would come.

pages.title: Here Am I
pages.scene: Isaiah seeing the angels around God's throne
pages.text: Isaiah saw God on a high throne, with angels calling, "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord!" Isaiah said, "I am not good enough!" An angel touched his lips and said, "You are forgiven." God asked, "Whom shall I send?" Isaiah said, "Here am I. Send me!"
pages.lesson: Say yes when God calls you.

pages.title: A Child Is Born
pages.scene: A bright light shining over a baby
pages.text: Isaiah said, "A child will be born for us. He will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace." This child is Jesus!
pages.lesson: Jesus is the Prince of Peace.

pages.title: The Peaceful Kingdom
pages.scene: A child leading a lion and a lamb
pages.text: Isaiah told about a wonderful time to come. The wolf will live with the lamb. The leopard will lie down with the goat. The lion will eat hay like an ox, and a little child will lead them. No one will hurt anyone anymore.
pages.lesson: God's kingdom is full of peace.

pages.title: Wings Like Eagles
pages.scene: An eagle soaring over the mountains
pages.text: "God never gets tired. He gives strength to people who are tired. Those who trust in the Lord will get new strength. They will fly high on wings like eagles. They will run and not get tired."
pages.lesson: Trust God, and He will give you strength.
